[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for improving running technique include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Maintain a tall, upright posture with ears, shoulders, hips, and ankles in alignment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Land midfoot or forefoot instead of heel striking to reduce joint impact.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Aim for a cadence of 160-170 steps per minute to maintain a consistent pace.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Keep arms relaxed and bent at around 90 degrees, avoiding crossing them over the body.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Practice deep, rhythmic breathing, inhaling for 2-3 steps and exhaling for 2-3 steps.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Engage core muscles to support posture and stability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Activate glutes and hips to drive the stride.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Focus on quick, light ankle movements, keeping them relaxed and flexible.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Listen to your body and adjust technique as needed, consulting a coach if necessary.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Practice consistently to improve technique over time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for 5K training include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Start with a gentle warm-up and cool-down to prevent injuries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Incorporate interval training and hill repeats to improve endurance and strength.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Include strength training exercises targeting core, glutes, and legs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Stay hydrated and maintain a balanced diet.
